title: Prime Number of Set Bits
description: Given two positive integers `left` and `right`, return the count of integers in the inclusive range `[left, right]` whose binary representation has a prime number of set bits (`1`s). Recall that `1` is not a prime number.
hints: Since `right <= 10^6 < 2^20`, the number of set bits in any value is at most 20.
Encode all primes up to 20 (`2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19`) in a single bitmask `665772` and test `(665772 >> popcount(x)) & 1` in O(1) time.

examples.explanation: In [10, 15], set-bit counts are 10->2, 11->3, 12->2, 13->3, 14->3, 15->4; five of them are prime.
1 has 1 set bit, which is not prime, so the count is 0.
